name: TNS Energo (PJSC GK TNS Energo)
note: Moscow Exchange-listed electricity sales holding (ticker TNSE). Kommersant reported (June 2025) that AO FinAlyans ST became the largest shareholder in 2024 after buying 28.6% of shares; Sunflake Limited (linked to arrested former owner Dmitry Arzhanov) is suing to reverse the sales. VTB reduced its stake in 2024 through a forward deal.
